title: Relationship Schema
description: A first-class, typed connection between objects (Vol 1 §19: USER owns DEVICE, ADMIN manages SERVICE, CERTIFICATE supports ASSERTION). Relationships must be EXPLICIT and TYPED - not hidden in undocumented conventions - so subject + predicate + object are required, with subject/object as references (OBJECT_REF != OBJECT, ALIAS != IDENTITY). Enforced by TOOLS/lore_validate.py Check 4. Closes the typed-relationship gap (P5 / external review).

subject.description: object-ref id of the subject (a reference, not the object).

predicate.description: the relation type/verb, e.g. owns, manages, supports. This is what makes the relationship TYPED.

object.description: object-ref id of the object (a reference, not the object).
